scopeReview: CED LIM-1.E: determine limits using the Squeeze Theorem. Includes provided bounds, derived absolute-value bounds, radian fundamental limit, sign-sensitive and one-sided applications. No epsilon–delta proof, derivatives, integration or BC-only content.
varietyReview: Eleven tasks span bounding limits, oscillation with vanishing amplitude, a denominator inequality, a fundamental trigonometric bound, insufficient bounds, one-sided information, bounded products, half-angle transfer, an error bound, negative-input inequalities and a sum. These are not eleven numerical substitutions of one template.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
